speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Systemic or Oligoarticular type) with potential genetic predisposition.

Given the age, unilateral swelling without trauma, and strong family history, we must confirm inflammation markers and rule out infection. Please confirm if the child has a fever, and I will request a CBC and ESR. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, ESR. REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_X-Ray_right.
